TNWC (Tuesday Night World Champs)

La Crosse, WI · Road

TNWC (Tuesday Night World Champs) is a road group ride in La Crosse, WI. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Smith's Bike Shop (route-dependent).

For visitors

Helmets are required on Smith's group rides. Check the shop calendar or the La Crosse Rides Facebook group for the start spot and route, which change with the route. Lights for dusk in fall.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intense; considered training for local racers. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the TNWC (Tuesday Night World Champs) group ride

Smith's Tuesday Night World Championships is a hard road ride that the shop describes as training for many of the local bike racers. It usually leaves Smith's Bike Shop at 5:30 pm, but the start time and place depend on the route. Expect a fast, drop-style group.
